chunks: 62 – al-Ḥusayn ibn Abī al-ʿAlā, al-Khaffāf, Abū ʿAlī, client of the Banū ʿAmir.
ai.seo_question: Who is al-Husayn ibn Abi al-A'la al-Khaffaf in Shia hadith literature?
ai.summary: This entry provides the biographical identification of a narrator, al-Ḥusayn ibn Abī al-ʿAlā, known as al-Khaffāf and Abū ʿAlī, indicating his status as a mawlā (client) of the Banū ʿAmir tribe.
